title: No PUN Intended: Plausible Unknown Names for Person-Centred LLM Evaluation
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate faith or religion. It focuses on developing a protocol (PUN) for generating plausible but operationally unknown person names to use as controlled variables in LLM evaluations (such as factuality, privacy leakage, and bias). Religion is only mentioned briefly as one of the demographic associations a person's name might carry.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion. The key findings relate to the operationalization and generation of unknown names, revealing that human participants and search engines are unable to recover real-person evidence for 97% of the generated plausible unknown names.
